tasks.title: Settle the zoekt risks and create the nested codesearch module with its policy tests
steps: Write TS-03-4, TS-03-7, TS-03-61, TS-03-62, TS-03-63 and TS-03-64 first and confirm they fail; add TS-03-60 once the Windows result is known

In a scratch module, pin a zoekt release and read its source: module path, packages for index builder, query parser and searcher, memory-vs-file shard search, per-document symbol fields (byte offsets), SearchOptions bounding result size and wall time. Record `go list -m all`, the CGO_ENABLED=1 cgo scan and the four-target build/vet outputs

Evaluate the no-go conditions: any cgo file in the graph, a need for gRPC/Prometheus/HTTP-server packages, or a builder that cannot take symbols from outside (TS-03-64 proves it can with CTagsPath empty). If one fails, stop, record the evidence in the PRD and merge no codesearch code; do not loosen any check

Implement the gate check as a small Go test helper with the literal thresholds 25% and one third (not parameters), two repositories of at least 5000 files and the Requirement 9 result; TS-03-7 asserts go/no-go outcomes

Create codesearch/go.mod: module github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch, `replace github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go => ..`, the pinned zoekt at an exact tag, and a header comment stating the boundary rule as difftest/go.mod does. Do not edit the root go.mod, go.sum or internal/policy

Create index.go, search.go, tool.go with minimal compiling skeletons, errors.go defining the exported ErrUnsupported value once for every platform, and a windows-constrained New stub returning ErrUnsupported only if zoekt fails on windows/amd64 (with the matching non-windows constraint on the real New)

Write codesearch/policy_test.go: TestNoCgoOutsideStdlib and TestCgoProbeIsArmed under CGO_ENABLED=1 (probe package with a cgo file), a forbidden-import check over `go list -deps` (grpc, prometheus, net/http servers) tested against a synthetic list, a cross-target build and vet of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 with CGO_ENABLED=0, and a stub test asserting errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupported) where the stub is used
Write the builder/searcher test TS-03-64: index a document with symbol sections as byte offsets and CTagsPath empty, assert sym: query matches, outranks a comment hit and no ctags process runs
Start codesearch/README.md with the measured figures, repositories and date, then the pinned-zoekt answers from step 2; also record them in the spec's external API notes
Run `go mod tidy` in codesearch and confirm `go list -deps ./...` in the root names no new module
done_when: `cd codesearch && go build ./... && go vet ./...` succeeds on the four targets with CGO_ENABLED=0

tasks.title: Add the standard-library seam to tools and the Invalidate hooks
steps: Write TS-03-8 to TS-03-14 and TS-03-5 first and confirm they fail

In tools add SymbolQuery, SymbolAnswer, the Index interface (Symbols, Tools, Invalidate, Close) and Options.Index, importing only the standard library and root packages; SymbolMatch is the type from spec 02
Export CapMarker and ClampLimit as thin wrappers over the unexported capMarker and clampLimit in tools/limits.go; the in-package test TS-03-9 compares them row by row, including limit == max

In tools.All append Index.Tools() after the built-in tools when Index is set and return (nil, error) naming the tool when a name equals a built-in; leave FileNavigationTools() and the nil-Index output untouched (compare with the spec 02 golden)

In write_file and edit_file call Index.Invalidate(filepath.ToSlash(rel)) exactly once per attempt after the write attempt, before the per-path lock is released, on success and failure paths (nil-safe when Index is nil)
In execute, run_command and powershell call Index.Invalidate("") exactly once on every return path (success, failure, timeout)
Write fakes recording Invalidate arguments and whether the lock was held; cover failure paths (edit_file old_string absent, unwritable path)
Confirm git diff shows no change to go.mod, go.sum or internal/policy and `go test ./internal/policy` passes unmodified

tasks.title: Build the index lazily: New, options, walk filter, outline symbols, shard directory and sweep
steps: Write the eight tests first and confirm they fail; tests obtain symbols only through a fake Runner or DisableCtags
Implement codesearch.Options and normalisation (defaults 100000 files, 1 GiB, 60 s, os.TempDir(), nil Env -> tools.ReducedEnv(nil))
Implement New(ws, opts) (tools.Index, error): error on nil ws; no goroutine, process, walk or disk access; internal build counter and test hooks
Implement the build: tools.Walk from the workspace root with IncludeHidden false and Options.Ignore, skip non-regular, >1 MiB or NUL-in-first-8KiB files and count them by reason

Collect symbols with outline.OutlineMany in batches of at most 100, outline.Options{Root, Runner}; Runner is Options.Runner, nil with DisableCtags, else tools.CtagsRunner(Env) created on first use; turn the outline.File decls of whichever backend into byte-offset symbol sections
Write documents under slash-separated workspace-relative names with zoekt's builder, CTagsPath empty, no git indexer; record (size, mtime, indexed-at) and the outline.File per file
Create <TempDir>/agentkit-codesearch-<sha256 prefix of at least 16 hex chars of absolute root>/<unique run id>/ with mode 0700

At build start sweep sibling run directories of the same hash older than 24 hours using an injectable clock, never touching another hash or another run; touch own directory at most hourly while queried
Verify TS-03-33 compares the indexed names with the filtered tools.Walk set on a fixture with nested .gitignore, nested repository, hidden dir, symlink, binary, oversized and exactly-1-MiB files

tasks.title: Implement the code_search tool: arguments, path conjunction, search and error codes
steps: Write the eight tests first and confirm they fail

Define the code_search tool in tool.go: Builtin, parallel, read-only, schema with required query and optional path, max_files, context_lines; description says "zoekt query syntax", never RE2, contains the four examples; PromptGuidelines carries the pinned sentence

Validate before any index work: trimmed-empty or over-1024-byte query, zoekt query.Parse failure (include parser message), negative context_lines -> invalid_arguments; default and clamp context_lines (2, MaxSearchContextLines) and max_files (10, tools.ClampLimit to 25)

Resolve path with Workspace.Resolve (path_not_allowed outside), stat it (read_failed when missing) before building; build a query.NewAnd conjunction with an anchored, regexp.QuoteMeta-escaped file: node (directory prefix with trailing slash, file anchored to the end, root adds nothing)
Return aborted ("Operation aborted") on a cancelled context, index_failed with the cause when the build fails for a non-bound reason, index_closed after Close, and search_failed for search errors

Run the first call's build lazily through the index from task 3 and search with the zoekt searcher with SearchOptions bounding wall time; cancel a query after 10 s (injectable duration) and return search_failed saying it timed out and should be narrowed
Expose a searcher test seam for TS-03-23 returning an error and one blocking until its context ends
Keep the first minimal result rendering so TS-03-18 and TS-03-20 can read the files; full rendering lands in the next task

tasks.title: Render ranked file-grouped code_search results with truncation markers and no-ctags header
steps: Write the nine tests first and confirm they fail; golden marker text is tied to the pinned zoekt version and a test comment says so

Convert zoekt FileMatch results into files in score order, at most max_files, at most 3 chunks per file in zoekt order with lines sorted ascending, context_lines either side, overlapping chunks merged, each line cut to tools.SearchLineChars

Render with RenderSearchText's shape (`N: matched line`, `N- context line`), a per-file header with the slash path (control characters -> ?), total match count, a note when matches were not shown and up to 5 declaration names (Container.Name for members) for matches on a declaration start line

Emit the first line: file count, index size, symbol sources as files per outline backend, ctags-unavailable note saying non-Go symbols are the heuristic's column-0 declarations only, and partial/dirty-overlay notes only when they apply
A no-match query returns OKResult with text saying nothing matched, the first line and empty Data.files
When more files matched than max_files append tools.CapMarker("files","max_files",limit,25,"narrow the query or add a path") and set Metadata.Truncated = TruncatedByLines

When the text exceeds tools.DefaultByteLimit drop whole files from the end keeping one, then drop that file's chunks from the end, append a bytes marker naming path, file: or fewer context_lines, and set TruncatedByBytes; ensure the final text is at most the limit including the marker
Populate Data: files, truncated, note, partial, symbol_sources, ctags_available, files_indexed, dirty_files and skipped counts

Write the property test TS-03-31 over generated zoekt queries, max_files 1..40, context_lines 0..30 and optional path, checking every marker's suggested call is not invalid_arguments and the text never exceeds the limit; use a Runner returning ErrCtagsUnavailable for TS-03-36

tasks.title: Enforce build bounds, cancellation, locking and Close lifecycle
steps: Write the six tests first and confirm they fail; run the concurrency test with -race

Apply the three bounds to a build: MaxFiles, MaxBytes and MaxBuildTime as a derived context passed to the walk, OutlineMany and the builder; on a bound keep what is indexed and mark partial with partial_reason files, bytes or time and the note to narrow path or use search_files
Never retry a partial index on later calls (build counter stays 1); leave only the dirty-threshold rebuild to replace it
On a cancelled call context during a build return aborted, discard the partial build and leave state unbuilt so the next call builds again
Guard index state with one lock: queries share a read lock, builds take the write side; a waiter behind a build selects on its context and returns aborted

Implement Close: wait for in-flight queries (test seam to hold one), release the zoekt searcher, delete the run directory, return nil on every call; afterwards tools return index_closed and Symbols returns ok=false without building or searching
Assert tools.All returns only ([]core.Tool, error), and that a never-closed run directory aged 25 hours is removed by a later index's sweep

tasks.title: Freshness: dirty marks, generations, revalidation walk and non-blocking Invalidate
steps: Write the six tests first and confirm they fail; use a blocking fake Runner, a revalidation counter and tools.All wired with the real index

Implement Invalidate(rel) under a small separate mutex setting a dirty entry with a monotonically increasing generation; it never blocks on a build or query, returns nothing and does not panic on a closed index
Keep Invalidate("") as a pending-revalidation flag with its generation
At query time remove every dirty path from indexed results so a deleted file appears in no result

Revalidation walk (same walk and filters as the build): compare (size, mtime) with indexed values, treat a file indexed within the previous 2 s as changed, mark changed and new files dirty and files no longer yielded dirty and gone
Run a revalidation before answering when a dirty path is unknown to the index or its base name is .gitignore; do not walk for a known non-.gitignore path
A build or revalidation pass clears only marks with a generation older than the pass's start generation, so a mark made mid-pass survives
With no Invalidate call never walk again: build counter 1 and revalidation counter 0 over 20 queries
Until the overlay lands, search dirty visible files by re-reading them minimally only if needed by the tests; the overlay replaces this in the next task

tasks.title: Overlay shard for dirty files, score merge and the 5% rebuild threshold
steps: Write the four tests first and confirm they fail; TS-03-49 is a property test over random sequences of write_file, edit_file (success and failure) and shell edit, delete and create
Index the still-visible dirty files into a small overlay shard with symbols from outline.OutlineMany on those files; rebuild it only when the dirty set changes (overlay build counter)

Run the same parsed query (with the path conjunction) against the indexed searcher and the overlay searcher and merge the hits by score, not by appending, so a fresh edit lower-scored than the cap still appears under max_files
Report dirty_files in Data and the dirty-overlay note in the first line

When more than 5% of indexed files are dirty, rebuild the whole index under the Requirement 5 bounds instead of using an overlay: build into a new run state, swap only when ready, close and delete the old shards after the swap

Queries arriving during a rebuild wait abandonably (ctx select) and use the new index; a waiter whose context ends returns aborted without waiting for the build; the old index stays valid until the swap
Verify 4 of 100 dirty gives build counter 1 and 6 gives 2 with the old shard directory contents gone
In TS-03-49 assert the latest content of every touched file appears, no overwritten or deleted content is shown and deleted files appear in no result

tasks.title: Serve find_symbol through Index.Symbols with identical matches
steps: Write the seven tests first and confirm they fail; TS-03-55 is a property test over generated trees and find_symbol queries comparing Index != nil with Index == nil

Implement Index.Symbols from the per-file outline.File data collected by the build (no zoekt query), using spec 02 Requirement 2 matching: smart-case prefix, exact, qualified Container.Name, kind (already lower-cased) and slash-separated path directory, producing tools.SymbolMatch values with file paths

Return (SymbolAnswer{Matches, FilesIndexed}, true, nil) only when the index was built by an earlier code_search, is not partial and not closed and the match count is at most 1000; otherwise (zero, false, nil) without starting a build
Before answering run any pending revalidation and re-outline dirty files in scope under the Requirement 6 rules
Return an error only when the context is cancelled

In tools' find_symbol add the Index branch: call Index.Symbols when Options.Index is set, rank and truncate with find_symbol's own code, name the index in the header backend line on ok=true, and fall back to the symbol table on ok=false; find_symbol never triggers a build (build counter 0 after find_symbol)
Add a fake tools.Index test confirming the fall-back path and the header, and assert the match order equals the table's

tasks.title: Wire the Makefile and update documentation
steps: Write the five tests first and confirm they fail
Extend the Makefile test, vet, lint and tidy targets to run in codesearch/ beside the root and difftest; confirm `make check` passes with and without universal-ctags on PATH
Audit every codesearch test: symbols come from a fake Runner or DisableCtags, a real-ctags test skips when exec.LookPath fails, seam tests use a fake tools.Index

Complete codesearch/README.md: the go/no-go figures first, what the module is, the one-line Options.Index opt-in plus allowlist entry, the Requirement 9 answers, known differences from search_files (1 MiB limit, zoekt dialect, score order) and that goldens are tied to the pinned zoekt version
Update docs/architecture.md (module boundary beside difftest/ and examples/flatline, package table and graph rows)
Update docs/DEPS.md with a new numbered ruling for zoekt confined to the nested module (pinned, what it buys, why hand-rolling a trigram index is not credible) and extend the nested-modules sentence
Update docs/configuration.md (Index row in the tools.Options table, code_search limits, codesearch.Options fields), docs/cli.md (make target descriptions) and the root README.md module list
Do not touch docs/api.md

tasks.title: Verify every execution path end to end against the real index
steps: Write the seven smoke tests against real components (real codesearch index, tools.All, tools.Walk, outline.OutlineMany, zoekt builder and searcher, file system) and confirm they pass; TS-03-75 runs the risk checks on a clean scratch module and on a cgo variant that must report no-go
Trace 03-PATH-1 through codesearch.New, tools.All, the code_search tool, tools.Walk, OutlineMany and the zoekt search; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains
Trace 03-PATH-2 and 03-PATH-3 from edit_file/write_file/execute to Index.Invalidate, the overlay shard, the revalidation walk and the result; confirm the tools call Invalidate from production code
Trace 03-PATH-4: confirm find_symbol in production code calls Index.Symbols (spec 02 entry point) and falls back to its table, and that the header names the index
Trace 03-PATH-5 and 03-PATH-6: partial bound without retry, and Close deleting the run directory then index_closed

For every criterion with a contract (Symbols ok/err, Invalidate arguments, index_closed, partial_reason, CapMarker) confirm the producer's result is consumed by a caller in production code, not only by tests
Grep every file in the tasks' touches for panic("not implemented"), TODO and bare `return nil` on non-trivial paths and remove them
Run `make check` and `go test -race ./...` in codesearch, with and without universal-ctags
